results.title: A Guerra à Santa
results.overview: Why does a Saint provoke such hatred in those who seek to rule the country?  For many people, Our Lady of Aparecida is the patroness of Brazil—the mother of Jesus.  Yet, Bishop JB Carvalho has labeled Aparecida the “right-hand woman of Satan” and called for her to be stripped of her status as Brazil’s patroness. It was in his very church that Flávio Bolsonaro chose to be baptized. Among so many pastors, why surround oneself with someone who spreads hatred against people’s faith?

results.title: Reconnection
results.overview: After a tense evening, a couple's argument over their lack of communication is cut short by a power outage.

results.title: The VelociPastor 2
results.overview: The perfect movie DOES exist! Doug and Carol travel to the port city of Milan, where they have to solve a series of murders committed by a masked slasher at an Italian Fertility Festival. And Soviet Spies. INTERPOL’s there, too.

results.title: A Sad and Beautiful World
results.overview: Across three decades of passion, loss, and hope, Nino and Yasmina are bound by a magnetic relationship. Torn between love and survival, they must decide whether to build a family in Lebanon or leave their home despite tragedies.

results.title: Impostor
results.overview: Everything works out for Mildred— even when it shouldn’t. Convinced that life is always on her side, she moves forward without hesitation… until one day her overconfidence is put to the test.

results.title: Rabbit Don't Run
results.overview: At 29, Toni is the top scorer of his local team and dreams of turning pro. Unable to play without painkillers, he steals them from his job as a nurse, risking disaster for himself and his family.

results.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
results.overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

results.title: Animal Justice
results.overview: Nick Morgan, a dedicated National Park Ranger, with a passion for wildlife takes a dark turn when he witnesses a brutal act of animal abuse. Nick embarks on a clandestine mission to protect these vulnerable creatures Will he find a way?

results.title: The Unknown
results.overview: David Zimmerman, almost 40, is a photographer but no one knows it. When friends drag him to a wild party, he spots a woman in the crowd and can’t take his eyes off her, he follows her… A few hours later, David wakes up: he’s in the body of the unknown woman.

results.title: Stakeout
results.overview: Two investigators stake out a library hoping to catch the mysterious Pepsitart Hardhat.

results.title: Grappling Grace
results.overview: A jazz-dancing Iranian-British wrestler opens a healing dojo inside a church, armed with a belief that wrestling and kindness will save the world. Nicknamed the Iranian Billy Elliot, Saeed Esmaeli has created a unique type of therapy for the beautiful misfits of society. However, when his mother suffers a sudden stroke everything changes. Caring for her strips away his certainty as the spiralling cost of care threatens to leave them homeless. Saeed's revolutionary work with offenders, refugees and neurodivergent children has been recognised by an honorary doctorate and an award from King Charles. GRAPPLING GRACE is about grief disguised as comedy and therapy disguised as combat. An uplifting short film about healing, creativity and the small acts that keep us human.

results.title: Joie de vivre
results.overview: A tribute to legendary 20th-century filmmaker Bernardo Bertolucci, examining his cinema, art, and life.

results.title: You Will Be Free
results.overview: Afghanistan, Spring 2002 — Following the fall of the taliban regime, the country faces extreme poverty. To feed his family, a father is forced to sell his 15-year-old daughter to a 65-year-old man. Refusing to accept this fate for her child, the mother, determined to give her a brighter future, arranges a marriage with a man living in Montreal. In return, she makes a solemn promise: the children born of this union will one day marry their cousins remaining in Afghanistan. Montreal, Spring 2020 — The pact resurfaces. Now well integrated into Quebec society, Zarmina refuses to let her 15-year-old daughter marry her cousin in Afghanistan. Her firm opposition triggers a tragic chain of events.

results.title: Kuyank
results.overview: Seven years prior to the breach of the mystical Saranjana portal, a remote stilt village built upon the treacherous swamps of interior Kalimantan becomes the epicenter of a terrifying theological crisis as the grotesque mechanics of an ancient black magic curse—the Kuyang—are violently unearthed.

results.title: A Little Park Music
results.overview: When a piano appears in the park gazebo, interfering with important work, city manager Allie joins forces with rookie cop Ryan to remove it, only to find both music and love are hard to resist.

results.title: The Thrifty Angel
results.overview: Wei Yi (38), a stingy suona player from Sichuan Folk Orchestra, reluctantly takes in his neighbor's 6-year-old son A Yu. Through their unexpected bond, the miser gradually transforms.

results.title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
results.original_title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
results.overview: The MANDAL Man debut half hour stand up comedy program recorded in Brooklyn, NY.

results.title: Curtain Call
results.overview: The fates of three Chicago socialites collide during a single doomed night at the Opera.

results.title: Sledgehammer Revealed
results.overview: Documentary looking back at the making of the music video for the Peter Gabriel single 'Sledgehammer'. Involving interviews from various crew members along with Peter Gabriel. Including a restored 4K version of the iconic music video.
